verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own docs describe project-wide multi-item work: fixing lint errors across a whole project, writing code across multiple files, spawning multiple agents on different parts of a task, and running multiple tasks in parallel. A hands-on report of a replace_all edit corrupting a constant concerns the reliability of bulk edits, not whether they exist, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: a documented explicit batch-operation mechanism with limits or semantics, independent corroboration of reliable bulk edits at scale, and evidence of bulk operations beyond code files (e.g. many tickets via MCP).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: fixing lint errors across a project, resolving merge conflicts, updating dependencies
